newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bunds shrug off weak European mkt to head higher.
newsitem.headline: Bunds shrug off weak European mkt to head higher.

text.p: Bund futures shrugged off weak debt markets around Europe on Thursday to post modest gains into record territory in later afternoon trade.
Traders said the market is seeing good trading volumes and that investors have grown more confident about German debt which has traded in progressively higher ranges in recent sessions.
Late in the afternoon, the DTB Bund futures contract was up six basis points at 101.78, after having spent the day between 101.94 and 101.60.
